description: This file contains the implementation of the LocalGrainDirectoryPartition class and the GrainInfo class, which manage grain activation data within Orleans runtime. It includes methods for adding, removing, merging, and querying grain activations, as well as internal logging and partition management logic.

classes.name: GrainInfo
classes.description: Represents information about a grain's activation, including its address, creation time, and version tag. Provides methods to determine if it can be removed, add or remove activations, and merge with other GrainInfo instances.

classes.name: LocalGrainDirectoryPartition
classes.description: Manages a partition of grain activations, supporting operations such as adding, removing, merging, splitting, and querying grain activation data, with thread safety and logging.

methods.name: OkToRemove
methods.description: Determines if a grain activation can be removed based on the cause and delay.

methods.name: TryAddSingleActivation
methods.description: Attempts to add a new activation address for a grain, updating internal state if successful.

methods.name: RemoveActivation
methods.description: Removes a specific activation of a grain, if conditions are met.

methods.name: Merge
methods.description: Merges another GrainInfo into this one, resolving conflicts arbitrarily.

methods.name: AddSingleActivation
methods.description: Adds a new activation to the directory partition, with validation.

methods.name: RemoveActivation
methods.description: Removes an activation from the partition, possibly removing the entire grain entry.

methods.name: RemoveGrain
methods.description: Removes all activations of a grain from the partition.

methods.name: LookUpActivation
methods.description: Retrieves the activation address and version tag for a grain.

methods.name: GetGrainETag
methods.description: Returns the version (ETag) of the grain's activation list.

methods.name: Merge
methods.description: Merges another partition into this one, returning activations to deactivate.

methods.name: Split
methods.description: Splits the partition based on a predicate, returning matching grain addresses.

methods.name: Set
methods.description: Replaces the internal partition data with new data.

methods.name: Update
methods.description: Applies delta updates to the partition data.
